The Gilded Daimyō, in AR

Point your phone at the armour photo. The samurai lifts out of the picture in gold, under a red sun, with sakura falling around him.

  1. 1Stand in front of the armour poster (or show the photo on another screen).
  2. 2On a phone the camera opens by itself; just allow it. Here, tap Start AR.
  3. 3Hold the photo in view. Tap the screen to strike; switch editions below.

Runs in the browser: no app to install. Works in Safari on iPhone and Chrome on Android.

This page needs to be opened from an https:// address for the camera to start. Upload it to any web host (for example Netlify Drop or GitHub Pages) and open that link on your phone.

This is the image the camera looks for. Point your phone at it right here on this screen.
